QUOTE: "The index was built with both macros forced on (`configured_macros_source: flag`), so the lock and thread data below describes the threaded build, not the default one."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the default library has no concurrency and the mutex code is compiled out. It never states that a default build creates no threads at all, and it never says the pthread example compiles to a stub main. Instead it lists the pthread server's thread as a spawn site in the threaded build.
